public_rationale: The claim has a checkable contextual reading, but the necessary experiment record was not recovered. The accessible text omits the images and associated prompt-and-output details. Marcus's own description cannot independently establish the failure. A contemporary commenter reported better results with a changed prompt, but the linked result was unreadable and would not necessarily contradict the original example. The evidence therefore supports neither acceptance nor rejection.
limitations: Unresolved reflects missing verifiable records, not evidence that the example succeeded.
A single example could establish a concrete failure but would not establish universal inability across AI systems.
Image-generation failure and image-interpretation failure require different comparisons.
